item.description: The rlp_encode function has several issues: incorrect handling of single-byte strings, improper integer encoding logic, and flawed address nonce tuple encoding. The current implementation doesn't properly follow RLP encoding specifications for various data types.
item.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to correctly encode integers, strings, and lists according to RLP specifications. For integers, handle the special case of 0 and properly encode integers < 128 as single bytes. For strings, correctly handle both text and hex modes, ensuring single-byte strings under 0x80 are encoded as-is. For lists, correctly calculate lengths and handle both short and long forms. For address nonce tuples, implement proper RLP encoding that correctly calculates data length and prefixes.

item.description: The rlp_decode function has issues with handling raw hex and prefix hex inputs, particularly in the types parameter handling and byte conversion logic. It fails to properly parse hex-encoded data and convert it back to the correct types based on the types parameter.
item.contract: Fix the rlp_decode function to properly handle raw hex and prefix hex inputs. Ensure that when data is passed in hex format, it's correctly converted to bytes before decoding. Also fix the types parameter handling to properly convert decoded bytes back to the requested output format (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex).

item.description: Several cryptographic functions are stubbed with NotImplementedError and need full implementations. These include private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, private_key_to_public_key, and pack_vrs functions.
item.contract: Implement the cryptographic functions for Ethereum key management: private_key_to_address should derive an Ethereum address from a private key, private_key_to_public_key should derive public key coordinates from a private key, sign_message_hash should create a signature for a message hash, and pack_vrs should pack signature components into a standard format.
